title: KELP: Kinematic Engine for Lagrangian Particles
description: A Lagrangian particle tracker for unstructured ocean model meshes (FESOM2, FESOM-C) and HEALPix grids: 2-D and 3-D advection with Euler, RK2, RK4 and adaptive RK45 integrators, temporal velocity reconstruction, rotated-frame tracking, stochastic diffusion, beaching, field sampling along trajectories, and streaming NetCDF/Zarr output with restarts.
